title: Mind The Gap (MTG-AD): Dataset and Fine-grained Evaluation for End-to-End Inline Audio Descriptions
abstract: arXiv:2610.39955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio descriptions (AD) are essential for making visual media accessible to blind and low-vision (BLV) users. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a scalable solution for generating audio descriptions on-demand, their performance on ``inline'' audio descriptions -- which must fit within existing silences in a video -- remains under-explored, particularly for diverse user-generated content (UGC). We present a comprehensive investigation into MLLM-generated inline audio descriptions. First, we introduce MTG-AD, a professionally annotated dataset of 36 hours of videos, each averaging $\sim$5 mins. and 8k+ descriptions in total, co-created by paired blind and sighted AD professionals to provide a high-quality benchmark for this task. Second, we propose MTG-AD-Eval, an evaluation framework based on audio description expert guidelines that provides fine-grained, reference-free actionable metrics for model improvement. Crucial

translated_title: Mind The Gap（MTG-AD）：面向端到端内联音频描述的数据集与细粒度评估
translated_abstract: 音频描述对于让盲人和低视力（BLV）用户无障碍地使用视觉媒体至关重要。虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为按需生成音频描述提供了可扩展的解决方案，但其在“内联”音频描述——即必须契合视频中现有静默间隙的描述——方面的性能仍未被充分探索，尤其是针对多样化的用户生成内容（UGC）。我们对MLLM生成的内联音频描述进行了全面研究。首先，我们推出了MTG-AD，这是一个由专业人员标注的数据集，包含36小时的视频，每个视频平均约5分钟，总计8000多条描述，由盲人与健视的音频描述专业人员配对共同创建，为该任务提供了高质量基准。其次，我们提出了MTG-AD-Eval，一个基于音频描述专家指南的评估框架，为模型改进提供细粒度、无需参考的可操作指标。
tldr: 该论文提出了MTG-AD——一个由盲人与健视专业人员配对共同标注的36小时视频内联音频描述数据集，以及基于专家指南的细粒度无参考评估框架MTG-AD-Eval，用于系统评估多模态大语言模型生成契合视频静默间隙的音频描述的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MTG-AD, a professionally annotated 36-hour inline audio description dataset co-created by paired blind and sighted experts, along with MTG-AD-Eval, a fine-grained reference-free evaluation framework based on expert guidelines, for assessing MLLMs on generating audio descriptions that fit within existing video silences.
